left.title: New Initiative
left.text: screenRIG is for screens that run without anyone tending them. A person places the stick and names the outcome. The agent enrolls, pairs, publishes, assigns, and verifies.

card.title: The Mini PC issue
card.text: Stick hardware stayed put. Mini PCs did not. 4 GB is now a floor.

fullpage.title: The RAM floor moved
fullpage.text: Mini PCs got more expensive. The stick did not. 4 GB is the cost floor.

card.title: RAM is shrinking
card.text: Cheap glass is the volume. The volume is where agents belong.

card.title: AI is now pretty smart
card.text: Agents write the playlist, not just a caption. screenRIG is how it runs on the glass.

card.title: The rise of agent-native
card.text: Agents do not click a UI. They speak an API. screenRIG is built so the operator is the agent.

card.title: Enter screenRIG
card.text: A headless service for agents. Humans place the stick and name the outcome. The agent does the rest.

title: This is screenRIG.
It works today.
fullpage.text: The API, the skill, the CLI, and the players are in source and running.

title: Humans place.
Agents run.
card.text: A person puts the stick in the display and names the outcome. The agent enrolls, pairs, publishes, assigns, and checks the screen.

card.title: Not the web.
card.text: Players are native. Stills and video decode on the device. Web is optional, not the product.

card.title: Native Video Playback
card.text: Nothing streams. The player syncs the file, then plays from disk.

fullpage.title: Sync first. Render on the device.
fullpage.text: A focused webapp capability. Experimental, not the primary use case.

cards.title: Package
cards.text: The CLI packs a static directory. Native players sync, then paint from disk.

cards.title: Not every platform
cards.text: Some players omit web. The PWA is a different path.

fullpage.title: The work stays on the agent machine.
fullpage.text: Video transcodes before upload. Layout composes locally. The agent sees the still, iterates, then hits the API.

title: Put your screens
in the conversation.
fullpage.text: Describe the outcome. The agent prepares, publishes, pairs, assigns, and verifies.
